job.question: In the Police Retirement System of St. Louis (PRS-STL) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the principal actuary have?
job.expected_facts: A minimum of five years of professional actuarial experience, plus a minimum of five years of experience testifying before legislative and administrative bodies.
job.acceptance: Five years professional actuarial experience is the core number. A complete description may state the separate five-year testimony requirement; these are not additive ten years and may overlap. Credentials are optional for this question.

reviews.reason: This is a Hawaii ERS real-assets investment consultant RFP, not the Police Retirement System of St. Louis actuarial RFP. Its experience requirement concerns a primary investment consultant, not a principal actuary; it provides no support for the requested actuarial requirement.
quotes: Employees’ Retirement System of the State of Hawaii (ERS) Request for Proposals Real Assets Investment Consultant RFP 2022-06 Issued October 3, 2022
The primary consultant assigned to the ERS account shall have a minimum of seven (7) years experience providing domestic and international real assets consulting services to public pension plans.
